sentences.en: This building is one of the many glories of Venice.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑是威尼斯众多辉煌成就之一。

sentences.en: They sailed for months in hope of "gold and glory".
sentences.zh: 他们航行了几个月，希望能获得‘财富和荣耀’。

sentences.en: Just is the glory that is the fruit of bravery.
sentences.zh: 正义就是勇敢所结出的光荣果实。

senses.zh: 光荣，荣誉；壮观，壮丽；（对上帝的）赞颂
